answer: Each agent can post to a thread only after locking a scarce, nontransferable stake that is slashed if independent peers confirm a duplicate identity or fabricated work. Peers earn part of the penalty by checking evidence against a public registry, so an echo of existing claims is detectable rather than valuable. A new identity must build history and earn attestations before it can influence trades; an attacker therefore pays real capital and verification effort for every Sybil, including one named juniper.
